title: Account Command Group
description: Implement all six account subcommands (add, list, remove, show, set-default, re-auth stub) as thin Spectre.Console command classes that delegate all logic to IAccountStore and IAuthProvider.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-3 complete. IAccountStore, PatAuthProvider, ZohoCorpGuard all exist and are tested. DI wired in Program.cs.
goal: All account subcommands execute end-to-end: account add contacts the Zoho user-info API, stores the PAT in the keychain, persists metadata to accounts.json; account list/show mask the token; account remove clears both keychain and accounts.json; account re-auth returns a NOT_IMPLEMENTED stub.
scope: Create src/CliqCli/Commands/AccountCommands.cs with AddAccountCommand, ListAccountsCommand, RemoveAccountCommand, ShowAccountCommand, SetDefaultAccountCommand, ReAuthAccountCommand — each a nested class extending AsyncCommand<TSettings> inheriting GlobalSettings

AddAccountCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) validate name unique via IAccountStore.FindAsync; (2) call Zoho user-info API GET https://accounts.{domain}/oauth/user/info with Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken <token> to retrieve email (OQ-001); (3) call PatAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync(name, token) passing email for ZohoCorpGuard; (4) build AccountEntry and append via IAccountStore.SaveAsync; (5) if first account set is_default=true; (6) write success envelope with account metadata — no token
ListAccountsCommand.ExecuteAsync: load all accounts, map to output DTO with token omitted and scope_count computed, write success
ShowAccountSettings: --name (req); ShowAccountCommand.ExecuteAsync: find account by name, render token field as '***', write success
RemoveAccountSettings: --name (req); RemoveAccountCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) find account; (2) PatAuthProvider.ClearTokenAsync; (3) remove from AccountsRoot, SaveAsync
SetDefaultSettings: --name (req); SetDefaultAccountCommand.ExecuteAsync: update is_default — only named account true, all others false, SaveAsync
ReAuthSettings: --name (req); ReAuthAccountCommand.ExecuteAsync: write error NOT_IMPLEMENTED 're-auth is not supported in v1; use account remove and re-add with a new PAT', exit 1
Register all six commands under 'account' branch in Program.cs

Unit tests: add duplicate name → ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS; add zohocorp PAT → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED; list masks tokens; show renders '***'; remove clears keychain + entry; set-default updates correctly
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
account add --name work --token xxx returns { "status": "ok", "data": { "name": "work", "domain": "zoho.com" } } — no token in data
account add with existing name → ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS on stderr, exit 1
account add with ZohoCorp PAT → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED on stderr, exit 1; nothing written to accounts.json or keychain
account list returns all accounts; no token value in any output field
account show --name work returns account with "token": "***"
account remove --name work removes keychain entry and accounts.json entry atomically
account set-default --name work sets is_default=true only for 'work'
account re-auth --name work → NOT_IMPLEMENTED on stderr, exit 1
No command class contains business logic beyond Validate() flag checks
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0002 for Spectre.Console command wiring. Read ADR-0006 for ZohoCorp block at account add. The user-info API is in OQ-001 default assumption. PatAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync is where ZohoCorpGuard fires — the command does not call ZohoCorpGuard directly. Token must never appear in success envelope or accounts.json. If --no-input is set and any required flag is missing, Validate() must return ValidationResult.Error — Spectre converts this to exit 1 with INVALID_ARGS.

openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-001. GET https://accounts.{domain}/oauth/user/info with Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken <token>. Response JSON has 'Email' field. 401 → AUTH_FAILURE. Network failure → IO_ERROR.
If accounts.json has 0 accounts before this add, set is_default=true on the new entry automatically.
